edits.why: the only prerequisite that decides whether this Skill runs at all was a clause in the middle of a paragraph, so a reader met it after installing. It is now the first thing under the title, in the words someone who has never heard of the Codex CLI can act on

the only runnable line in the Skill assumed one agent's install directory. The installer writes into whichever agent it chose (.claude, .codex, .cursor and so on), so the copy points at the script beside it instead of at a path that is right for one reader and wrong for the rest
